findings.finding: The motion remains the Christian God, while Craig explicitly uses a cumulative route. Pigliucci questions Christian specificity and distinguishes nonbelief from proving impossibility; his positive naturalistic claims elsewhere remain assessable. Craig’s claim of an opponent concession is preserved as his claim, not authenticated as an actual unconditional concession.

The initial finite-past and causal argument is distinct from its personal-agent inference. Natural-origin, regress, quantum-vacuum, eternal-cause, and later causal-uncertainty replies are all retained. No recognition-corrupted proper name or numerical cosmology claim is treated as a demonstrated error.

The inventory preserves Craig’s law/chance/design alternatives and Pigliucci’s initial complexity response plus later probability criticism. Pigliucci’s general natural complexity discussion is not silently promoted into a direct solution of physical fine-tuning.

Local objectivity, adaptation, prescription, sanctions, cross-society judgment, scriptural goodness, the goodness dilemma, and the divine-nature answer retain distinct inferential roles. The source distinguishes knowledge of morality from its proposed foundation. Biblical citation wording remains recognition-limited; contextual disagreements may be assessed without treating transcription errors as speaker errors.

The three-fact case, competing source and genre accounts, natural explanations, sincerity, Jewish context, and rival miracles all appear. Pigliucci first disputes the facts and then conditionally grants them; Craig’s origin-of-belief argument is not reduced to strength of conviction. The closing conflict-with-laws challenge is included before the excluded audience period.

The non-inferential experiential claim, brain-based alternative, external-world comparison, brain-mediation refinement, and realist parsimony reply are distinct. Possibility, veridicality, public proof, and reasonable personal belief are not silently equated.

spanReview.longSpanDisposition: Each longer span has a source-specific argument-completeness rationale. Cumulative premises and their qualifications remain together; event-granularity transition fragments do not supply independent evidence. Full approved context remains available to judges.
spanReview.fourthRows: Motion framing uses four distinct pro burden formulations; morality and resurrection each require four distinct moves per side. The frozen capacity audit provides topic-specific nonmergeability reasons.
